name: Long Ago FM
brief: True stories from history told as narrative: forgotten people, strange events, the day something changed. Research primary-ish sources (museum, university, encyclopaedia, archive pages); keep dates and names right; tell it with suspense and scene-setting.
clock: the story (3-4 min, narrator leads, co-host reacts)
